The three plans that executed here (physics-spine-adoption, mast-catalog-geometry-recovery, mast-machine-description) moved to S5 with their follow-on work: registry digest-change corrections, the vacuum-floor calibration ladder, solve-input ingest maps, and deep-donor importer migration. sprints.description: Calibrate the MAST machine description to the measurement floor. The S2 cutover passed on a measured cross-source budget; this sprint makes that budget moot by completing turns/circuits, adjudicating sensor poses and winding lattices, and calibrating passive R/L on the archive's designed vacuum experiments, until the artifact path beats the incumbent on absolute whitened sensor misfit and approaches the quantified noise envelope.
